models.$comment: design — только для поиска кандидатов голоса (--audition); реплики озвучивает clone

personas: Elderly Russian man, about 75 years old, a grumpy but kind grandfather playing dominoes. Low, deep, hoarse voice with a gravelly rasp. Slow, unhurried speech with pauses, a little grumbling. Natural Russian intonation.
Old Russian man in his late seventies. Low bass-baritone, husky and smoky timbre, slightly creaky at the ends of phrases. Calm, measured, slow tempo; dry humor, warm underneath.
Russian grandfather, about 80 years old. Deep, rough, raspy voice, low pitch, speaking slowly and deliberately, gruff but good-natured, with a hint of a chuckle.
Tall thin elderly Russian man, about 72, with a low, slightly nasal and hoarse voice. Unhurried, drawling, thoughtful manner, softly grumbling, kind at heart.

reference.text: Ну, здра́вствуй. Сади́сь, забьём козла́. Костя́шки ждут.

build.$comment: tools/audio/build-voice.mjs: только постоянное усиление (без loudnorm в динамическом режиме) и без обрезки краёв — характер живой записи не меняется; плавные вход 5 мс и выход 8 мс остаются (D51).
